sql: CREATE TABLE audit_view_private.audit_view_base(id INT PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE VIEW audit_view_private.audit_visible AS SELECT id FROM audit_view_private.audit_view_base
CREATE VIEW public.audit_visible AS SELECT 1 AS id
SELECT schemaname,viewname,viewowner=current_user AS owned,definition IS NOT NULL AS defined FROM pg_catalog.pg_views WHERE viewname='audit_visible' ORDER BY schemaname
SELECT n.nspname FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE c.relname='audit_visible' ORDER BY n.nspname
SELECT schemaname,viewname,viewowner,definition FROM pg_catalog.pg_views WHERE viewname='absent_audit_view'
